slug: 2026-03-02 Botswana - Minister envisions reforms to boost service delivery (digital Omang)

facts.fact: BOPA reports that in the Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs' 2026/27 recurrent budget request, P105 million under Civil and National Registration will fund Omang card production and the maintenance of the Births and Deaths Registration System; no share for the BDRS is given.

systems.owner: Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs, Civil and National Registration

systems.system: Electronic Identification System / Digital ID project
systems.country_label: Electronic Identification System; Digital ID project
systems.owner: Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs
systems.tiers: planned; first prioritised for 2025/26 as a public-private partnership, since widened to digital IDs, a national e-wallet and e-government services

systems.owner: Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs
systems.tiers: within P42 million of computerisation projects in the 2026/27 development budget

note: The BDRS is named with no description of what it does; classed civil on its name being that of the births and deaths register, as in document 7. The date is the article's, 2 March 2026.
